Check October 29 holiday updates for Delhi and three states School holiday October 29: Schools in Delhi, Punjab, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh may follow different holiday schedules on October 29, 2026, for Karwa Chauth. Government schools in Delhi are reported to be closed for the festival, while some educational institutions in Punjab and Rajasthan have listed it as a holiday or restricted holiday. However, school holiday arrangements vary by state and institution. Students and parents should check official school notices before making plans for Thursday. A restricted holiday listed in a government office calendar or an individual institution's academic schedule does not automatically establish a closure for all government and private schools. Are schools closed in Delhi on October 29? Government schools in Delhi are reported to remain closed on October 29, 2026, for Karwa Chauth. The Delhi government's 2026 holiday calendar also lists the festival as a restricted holiday. Parents should check the latest Directorate of Education circular or their school's official notice for confirmation. Private schools may follow their own academic calendars and management decisions. Students should confirm whether classes and examinations will take place before assuming that their school will remain closed. Are schools closed in Punjab on October 29? Some educational institutions in Punjab have included Karwa Chauth in their 2026–27 academic calendars as a holiday or restricted holiday. The Tribune School, for example, lists October 29 as a restricted holiday. This entry applies to the institution's calendar and does not establish a statewide holiday for all schools in Punjab. Parents should consult their school's official holiday list or contact the administration to confirm the status. Is Karwa Chauth a school holiday in Rajasthan? The Rajasthan High Court's 2026 calendar lists Karwa Chauth on October 29 as a restricted holiday. However, the calendar covers High Court-related holidays and does not confirm that all government and private schools across Rajasthan will remain closed. Students and parents should check their school's academic calendar, state education department announcements or notices issued by the relevant district authorities. Will schools remain closed in Uttar Pradesh on October 29? The 2026 holiday list for Central Government administrative offices includes Karwa Chauth on October 29 as a restricted holiday. This provision applies to Central Government offices and does not establish a holiday for all schools in Uttar Pradesh. No confirmed statewide announcement has established a closure for all government and private schools across the state. Parents should check school circulars and announcements from district education authorities for the latest instructions. School holiday status on October 29, 2026 State Holiday status 
 Delhi Government schools are reported to be closed; private school arrangements may vary. 
 Punjab Some institutions list Karwa Chauth as a holiday or restricted holiday; confirmation is required. 
 Rajasthan Listed as a restricted holiday in the High Court calendar; statewide school closure is unconfirmed. 
 Uttar Pradesh Restricted holiday listed for Central Government offices; statewide school closure is unconfirmed. 
 What should students and parents check? Students and parents should check official school websites, circulars and messages from school administrations for confirmation. They can also consult the relevant education department or district authority for applicable orders. Until an official notice confirms a closure applicable to their school, families should not assume that all schools will remain closed on October 29 for Karwa Chauth.
